definitions.search:
T43 P2: overbar_0 ACROSS the crate, inside the handles. CPU, 1 process per call.
usage: p2search.py TAG [TAG ...]  -> raw/p2search_<TAG><P2_SUFFIX>.json

Slot     : overbar_0 (pi05_TO_hybrid c7c1cc9 / fce4af8): capsule bar (radius r) along the slot's local x at bar_height h above the
           table (bar centre), 2 cylinder legs r 0.012 at position +- R(yaw)[L/2, 0, 0] from the table up to the bar axis.
Frame    : crate frame (body 'crate' at the reset scene).  u = bar-centre x_rel, v = bar-centre y_rel; s = +1 when the apple starts
           at y_rel > 0 (left-arm episodes), -1 otherwise (ep1834, right arm); the grid is over |v| on the apple side (v = s*|v|).
           dyaw = overbar yaw - crate yaw; dyaw 0 = bar along the crate x axis = across the crate's short dimension (walls at
           x_rel +-0.090, the long walls); legs then stand at x_rel = u +- L/2.
Crate    : outer |x_rel| <= 0.090, |y_rel| <= 0.150; interior |x_rel| < 0.082, |y_rel| < 0.142; wall top 0.120 m above the table;
           handles |y_rel| 0.150..0.210, top 0.157 (probe.json).
Grid     : |v| in P2_V (default 0.02..0.13 step 0.01), u in P2_U (default -0.02, 0, 0.02), dyaw in P2_DYAW (default 0, +-5 deg),
           L in P2_L (default 0.22..0.34 step 0.03), h in P2_H (default 0.14..0.30 step 0.01), r in P2_R (default 0.012).
Rows     : as T43 P: WU = reset scene + 1000-step warmup replay every 50 steps; T0 = recorded planning row 0 of E0 and E3b;
           PRE = control rows t < lift_t; CAR = control rows lift_t <= t < place_t.
Metric   : min pair_distance (manager, certified) over rows and (overbar geom, set geom) pairs, branch-and-bound, cap 0.06 m.
Criteria : a' = min(ROBOT over WU and T0) >= 0.030;
           b  = CRATE, APPLE, FRUITS over WU row 0 and T0 > 0, client reset check (ARMS > 0.02, object > 0), and legs_outside_crate
                (each leg circle, r 0.012, lies outside the crate outer footprint);
           c  = min(GRIP, APPLE) over CAR <= 0 in E0 AND E3b; c_apple = min(APPLE) over CAR <= 0 in E0 AND E3b;
           d  = min(ROBOT, APPLE) over PRE >= 0.030 (both runs);
           e  = free_height_over_bar >= 0.05 m: kinematic max TCP z of the used arm (SLSQP, approach axis within 15 deg of the
                recorded carry axis, no collision check) at the crossing point (where the recorded apple path crosses y_rel = v,
                projected on the bar axis), max over E0/E3b, minus the median TCP - apple-bottom offset over the carry rows, minus
                the bar top (h + r); drop_gap_m = (|v| - r) + 0.142 = y distance from the bar's crate-centre edge to the far
                interior wall face (reported, with the apple's horizontal size).
definitions.selection:
T43 P2 step 2: choose one overbar placement per episode, write the config (red rgba), cross-check.
usage: select_p2.py TAG [TAG ...]  -> configs/t43p2_ep<EP>_s<SEED>.json, raw/select_p2_<TAG>.json

Pool     : raw/p2search_<TAG>.json (+ _refine when present).
Main     : pass a', b (incl. legs outside the crate), c (GRIP or APPLE hits the bar in E0 AND E3b), d, e.
Ranking  : (1) margin = min(a_min, d_min) capped at 0.06 m, rounded to 1 mm (larger first); (2) c_apple (the apple itself hits
           the bar in both runs) first; (3) place_spot_clear first: in both runs the recorded final apple centre lies at least
           r + 0.035 m (apple half-size) beyond the bar axis toward the crate centre (crate-frame y); (4) |dyaw| smaller first;
           (5) depth_ok first: max over runs of min(GRIP, APPLE) over CAR <= -0.020 m (the recorded path is >= 20 mm inside the
           bar in both runs); (6) larger |v| (closer to the apple-side end wall); (7) smaller |u| (legs symmetric about the
           crate); (8) crate clearance b_crate_min capped at 0.030 m, rounded to 1 mm; (9) deeper blocking; (10) larger
           free_height_over_bar.  (v1 of this ranking, raw/select_v1/, put the blocking depth rounded to 5 mm before |v| and
           had no |u| term.)
Trade-off: when no candidate passes: best value of each criterion with the others held (a_best_given_bcd, d_best_given_abc,
           c_miss_best_given_abd = smallest max-over-runs CAR minimum among a', b, d passers) and a maximin candidate (worst slack
           of min(a_min - 0.030, d_min - 0.030, b_crate_min, b_obj_min, client_reset_arms - 0.020, -max c) among b passers).
Cross-check of the written config: (1) manager.activate (the client's call) vs the search's _place path: robot/object reset
           clearance and every overbar geom pose; (2) brute force (every row, every overbar x set geom pair, no bound) minima for
           a_min, d_min, b_crate_min, CAR per run, vs the search values; (3) independent numpy GJK (T40 A gjk.signed_dist) at the
           argmin pair of a_min, d_min, b_crate_min and each run's CAR minimum; (4) dryrun_p2.py = the fce4af8 client's own reset
           check (pi05_infer.main() up to the policy call, --obstacle-stop-distance 0.02).
definitions.other_seeds:
T43 P2: the chosen overbar against EVERY recorded E0 / E3b run of the episode (all policy seeds in outputs/verify/T39/runs and
outputs/verify/T42/1/runs/*/noobs with a .done marker), not only the search seed.  Per run: T42-1 analyze rule (grasp_t, place_t,
success), lift_t (T40 A rule), and with the config's overbar (manager._place = activate geometry, cross-checked in select_p2):
  car_min  = min(GRIP, APPLE) over control rows lift_t <= t < place_t (<= 0: the recorded path hits the bar), car_apple = APPLE only;
  pre_min  = min(ROBOT, APPLE) over control rows t < lift_t (criterion d: >= 0.030);  t0_robot = recorded planning row 0.
Distances: branch-and-bound p2search.PCtx.bb_multi (certified pair_distance), cap 0.06 m.
usage: check_seeds.py TAG [TAG ...]  -> raw/check_seeds_<TAG>.json
